proposed.text: A 500 sq.m. Basic R-2 lot without firewall is to be developed to maximum allowed limits per Table VIII.1. What is the AMBF (Allowable Maximum Building Footprint) in square meters?

options.text: 225 sq.m. — 45% of 500 sq.m., applying the TOSL percentage as the building footprint
275 sq.m. — 55% of 500 sq.m., applying the PSO for Basic R-2 without firewall
300 sq.m. — 60% of 500 sq.m., applying the PSO for Basic R-2 with firewall
425 sq.m. — 85% of 500 sq.m., applying the MACA percentage as the building footprint

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: AMBF = TLA x PSO. For Basic R-2 without firewall (Table VIII.1): PSO = 55%. AMBF = 500 x 0.55 = 275 sq.m. Option A confuses TOSL (45%) with PSO. Option C uses the firewall PSO (60%) for a project without firewall. Option D confuses MACA (85%) with PSO — MACA covers both building and paving, not just the building footprint.
proposed.explanation: AMBF = TLA x PSO. PSO is a percentage; AMBF is the actual area in sq.m. Basic R-2 without firewall: PSO=55%, so AMBF = 500 x 0.55 = 275 sq.m. The common trap is using MACA (85%) instead of PSO (55%) to compute AMBF. MACA governs total hard coverage (building + paving), not the building footprint alone.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096, Rule VIII, Sec. 803.3; Table VIII.1
